evidence.note: Reads all provided integration test files (storage_lifecycle, kubernetes_compatibility, controller_verification, networking_conformance, kubectl) and test helpers before coding — solid per-crate contract reading.

Maps the whole cross-crate API surface up front via grep -rn 'use rusternetes_*' across crates/ and tests/, and articulates the leaf-first dependency order (common -> storage -> api-server -> ...).
Correctly infers the /registry/{resource}/{namespace}/{name} storage-key format from storage tests, showing contract inference from fixtures.
Last consultation of the upstream reference (Container struct in core/v1 types.go); after this the reference is never opened again despite ~350 remaining steps.

Work shifts to an error-driven fix loop: grep test-compiler errors and run large 'megafix' Python scripts to pattern-match field names to failing tests — fixture-fitting, not reference-grounded, for scheduler/kubelet/kube-proxy/kubectl/cloud-providers.
Late/end phase remains cargo-error-driven; conformance-suite semantics are cited only as boilerplate in analyses and never investigated; no re-grounding of new behaviors in the source of truth.

reasoning: Early orientation is strong and clearly exceeds anchor 5: the agent reads each crate's tests and Cargo.toml, maps the entire cross-crate use-graph up front, understands the dependency order, and consults the v1.35 reference to reconstruct camelCase JSON, the /registry key format, and core type shapes. But this source-of-truth investigation stops entirely after ~step 95, and the remaining ~80% of the trajectory (8 of 10 crates) is driven by grepping compiler errors and running Python 'megafix' scripts that pattern-match test failures — the very fixture-fitting the task warns against — with no re-consultation of the reference and only boilerplate mentions of conformance. That falls short of anchor 8's systematic, whole-horizon reference mining and well short of anchor 10's sustained re-grounding, placing the observed behavior at a 6 (above 5 for the up-front mapping and reference use, below 8 for the abandonment).
